description: Welcome to Lavie Maison! Situated in the heart of the lively Sentier district, this elegant 90 m² flat is ideal for exploring Paris. It features 4 comfortable bedrooms, 5 double beds and 4 bathrooms, offering plenty of space and privacy for everyone. You’ll enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, a television, a coffee machine, a washing machine, a microwave, an oven, a dishwasher and everything you need for a comfortable stay.The spaceThis 90 m² (969 sq ft) apartment, ideally located in the heart of the Sentier district, is perfect for families, groups of friends, or business travellers. It features 4 spacious bedrooms with 140x200 cm double beds, as well as a sofa bed in the living room, providing several comfortable sleeping arrangements. The 4 private bathrooms ensure comfort and privacy for every guest throughout their stay.The bright living area is the perfect place to relax and spend time together after exploring Paris. A fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals with ease. Thanks to its generous layout and practical design, the apartment offers a comfortable stay in central Paris, within walking distance of shops, restaurants, and many of the city's main attractions.Guest accessThe flat is reserved entirely for your use during your stay. From the moment you arrive, you are free to make use of the four bedrooms, four bathrooms, the living room and the fully equipped kitchen.For added flexibility, you can gain access independently via a smart lock. Whether you arrive early, late in the evening or after a flight, you’ll be able to enter the property easily without having to arrange a meeting to collect the keys. All the necessary information will be provided to you before your arrival to ensure a smooth and stress-free check-in.Other things to no
